summary.text: Eric Conroy is the Republican nominee, a Cincinnati native, U.S. Air Force Academy graduate and Air Force veteran who later worked as a CIA case officer. He announced his candidacy in July 2025 and says he is running on national security, border security, fiscal responsibility and energy independence.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised on the West Side of Cincinnati; graduated from Elder High School.
Graduated from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 2011 and served in the U.S. Air Force from 2011 to 2018.
Later worked overseas in national security as a CIA case officer, according to his campaign materials; Fox News described him as a former CIA case officer when he announced his campaign.
Earned a graduate degree from Columbia University in 2025.
Announced his campaign for Ohio's 1st District in July 2025 and has been endorsed by U.S. Sen. Bernie Moreno, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

sources.title: SCOOP: Former CIA officer, Air Force veteran launches GOP campaign for Dem-held Ohio district
